about.title: More than time
about.intro: WristWatch.uz is a watch brand from Uzbekistan. We offer watches that combine style, quality, and value. Our goal isn't just to sell watches — it's to create a place where customers can confidently choose a timepiece that reflects their personality and lifestyle.
about.mission_text: To make premium-looking, high-quality watches accessible while providing a trustworthy and enjoyable shopping experience.
about.vision_text: To become one of the most recognized and trusted watch brands in Uzbekistan, and eventually build a strong international presence.
about.philosophy_text: Every watch reflects more than time — it reflects the wearer's discipline, confidence, ambition, and timeless style. To us, a wristwatch is a symbol of character, professionalism, and taste.
about.care_title: How to care for your watch
about.care_1_text: Most watches are 3-5 ATM (30-50m) water resistant — fine for rain or hand-washing, but not for swimming or showering. Check the rating on the case back.
about.care_2_text: Avoid leaving your watch in direct sunlight or heat — it can damage the movement and leather strap. Store it in a cool, dry place when not worn.
about.care_3_text: Magnets in phones, laptop speakers, or bag clasps can affect a mechanical watch's accuracy — keep your watch away from them.
about.care_4_text: Wipe a leather strap with a soft, dry cloth. A metal bracelet benefits from an occasional wipe with a slightly damp cloth for long-lasting shine.
about.types_text: Quartz movements run on a battery, offering accuracy and low-maintenance care — ideal for everyday wear. Mechanical (automatic) watches are powered by the motion of your wrist, representing traditional craftsmanship — prized by collectors and enthusiasts alike.
about.craft_1_text: Impact-resistant, keeps its shine for years.
about.craft_2_text: Tested for high accuracy and reliable running.
about.timeline_1_text: The idea was born to bring quality, elegant watches within reach of every Uzbekistani.
about.timeline_2_text: Reliable suppliers and quality-control standards were established.
about.timeline_4_text: On the path to becoming a leading, internationally recognized watch brand.
